preconditions.description: n is the number of stations (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000), m is the number of commuters (0 ≤ m ≤ 100000), and K is the total units of nitro (0 ≤ K ≤ 10000000).

preconditions.expression: len(distances) == n - 1 and all(0 < d <= 100 for d in distances)
preconditions.description: The distances list contains exactly n-1 integers, each representing the distance between consecutive stations (1 ≤ d_i ≤ 100).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t <= 10000000 and 1 <= s < e <= n for t, s, e in commuters)
preconditions.description: Each commuter is represented by a tuple (t_i, s_i, e_i) where t_i is the arrival time (0 ≤ t_i ≤ 10000000), s_i is the boarding station (1 ≤ s_i < e_i ≤ n), and e_i is the destination station.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimal total travel time for all commuters.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= departure_time <= arrival_time + travel_time for departure_time, arrival_time, travel_time in bus_events) if 'bus_events' in locals() else True
postconditions.description: The bus departs from a station only after all commuters who board at that station have arrived, and the travel time is calculated based on the distance and nitro usage.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= nitro_used <= K) if 'nitro_used' in locals() else True
postconditions.description: The total nitro used does not exceed the available K units.

postconditions.expression: total_travel_time == sum((departure_time[e_i] - arrival_time) for arrival_time, s_i, e_i in commuters)
postconditions.description: The total travel time is the sum of the time each commuter spends on the bus, calculated as the departure time at their destination minus their arrival time at the boarding station.
